And Conditions As Deemed Fit.
 This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Petitioner-accused No.1 is before this Court seeking grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in Crime No.79/2022 of Davanagere Women Police Station, pending in S.C.No.137/2022 on the file of the Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I, Davanagere, registered for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC') and Sections 6 and 17 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short 'POCSO Act, 2012'), on the basis of the first information lodged by the informant Smt.Roopa B.
2.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Sri.Maruthi G.B., learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri.B.Lakshman, learned HCGP for the respondent No.1-State.
Perused the materials on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner is arraigned as accused No.1.
He is innocent and has not committed any offence as alleged in the prosecution.
He has been falsely implicated in the matter without any basis.
He was apprehended on 09.06.2022 and since then he is in judicial custody.
Accused Nos.2 to 4 are already enlarged on bail.
The investigation has been completed and charge sheet is also filed.
Victim is already examined as P.W.1.
Prosecution has cited as many as 31 witnesses.
Examination of these witnesses will take sufficient longer period of time.
He submitted that victim has now attained the age of majority.
Petitioner is now aged 21 years.
Since the investigation is already completed, the detention of the petitioner in custody would amount to pre-trial punishment.
The petitioner is the permanent resident of the address mentioned in the cause title to the petition and is ready and willing to abide by any of the conditions that would be imposed by this Court.
Therefore, petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
4. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader opposing the petition submitted that serious allegations are made against the petitioner for having committed the offences.

sentences.text: The victim was minor when the offence in question was committed.
Victim has fully supported the case of the prosecution, when she was examined as P.W.1.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner is not entitled for grant of bail.
Hence, he prays for dismissal of the petition.

5. In view of the rival contentions urged by learned counsel for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
"Whether the petitioner is entitled for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.?"

My answer to the above point is in 'Affirmative' for the following:
REASONS 6.

Serious allegations are made against the petitioner for offences punishable under Sections 363,
366(A), 376 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 6 and 17 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Admittedly, the investigation is completed and charge sheet is also filed.
In the meantime, petitioner was apprehended on 09.06.2022.
Admittedly, victim is examined as P.W.1.
It is stated that she has fully supported the case of NC: 2024:KHC:2307 prosecution.
Charge sheet discloses that prosecution has cited as many as 31 witnesses.
Examination of these witnesses will take sufficiently longer period of time.
In addition, petitioner is aged 21 years.
Detaining the petitioner in custody may bring him in contact with hard core criminals, which is not advisable.

Under such circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled to be enlarged on bail subject to conditions, which will take care of the apprehension expressed by the learned High Court Government Pleader that the petitioner may abscond or may tamper or threaten the prosecution witnesses.

7. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the affirmative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.79/2022 of Davanagere Women Police Station pending in S.C.No.137/2022 on the file the Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I, Davanagere, on obtaining the bond in a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs only) with two sureties for NC: 2024:KHC:2307 the likesum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court, subject to the following conditions:
a) The petitioner shall not commit similar offences.
b) The petitioner shall not threaten or tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
